description: Host truth. Opens the real page (its scripts run) in headless Chrome, performs actions on the element as a finger or a key would, measures it every frame (translate, scale, rotation, opacity, size, and whether it is still there), and says what the page actually showed. With `file`, judges the page against the file under the same actions: played as the file says, differs, never shown (the element left the page), or nothing moved. Needs a local Chrome.

actions.description: What to do, in time order: { "action": "tap", "t": 0.1 }. Actions are down, up, tap (down, held 80 ms, up), hover, leave, or key:<name> (a letter, or escape, enter, space, tab, arrow keys, home, end, pageup, pagedown, backspace, delete, f1-f12: every key the format names). The page's own handlers run, so a click that navigates away will.

events.description: The file's events to judge against. Default: the actions, as the file's events on `on`, at the times they actually happened.

dx.description: Horizontal travel of the drag, in logical units.

dy.description: Vertical travel of the drag, in logical units.

t.description: Seconds, or a string like "100ms". For a drag, when it starts.

file.description: Path to a .nudg.json file, relative to the working directory.

on.description: Which of the file's targets the actions are for. Default: the first target that handles them (a toggle's track, not its knob).

reducedMotion.description: Play as a reduced-motion user would see it: short linear tweens, no kicks (0.3).

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to measure; shadow roots are searched. Default, with `file`: [data-nudg="<the file's first target>"].

settle.description: Seconds to keep measuring after the last action. Default 1.5.

start.description: Start in these states instead of initial, e.g. ["on"].

url.description: An http(s) URL of the running app, or a local .html path (served from the working directory).

warmup.description: Seconds to let the page's scripts start first. Default 0.5.

name: nudg_observe
title: Observe the real page
